C.quote: My back used to be sore sometimes. Now it holds a grudge.

D.quote: I used to stay out until midnight. Now I'm in bed by nine, awake by two, and thinking about something I said in 1998.

C.quote: I've started saying "back in my day" about shit that happened last spring.

D.quote: I don't say "no" to plans anymore. I say "let me check" and never check.

C.quote: I got dressed up to go out and was home by 8:15, proud of both decisions.

D.quote: I used to worry about being late. Now I worry about being early and having to make conversation.

C.quote: I bought a nice pan to become a better cook. The pan is doing great. I'm still ordering dinner.

D.quote: Every year I learn to say no. Every year I volunteer for something by February.

C.quote: I finally have the patience of an adult. It showed up the same year my energy left.

D.quote: I don't forget names. I file that shit somewhere I can't reach.

C.quote: Somewhere along the way, "I'll call you back" became my love language.

D.quote: My plans for the day: nothing. I'm protecting it.

C.quote: My kids moved out and took all the noise with them. I miss about half of it.

D.quote: I used to chase dreams. Now I chase the one hour a day when the house is quiet.

C.quote: I keep a list of things I'll do when I have time. The list has now outlasted my last three jobs.

D.quote: I clean for company, then spend the whole visit apologizing for a mess I can't see.

C.quote: Everything costs double, my patience is gone, and the coupon expired yesterday. That's some bullshit.

D.quote: I bought a planner to get organized. The planner is gorgeous. I've now lost the planner.

C.quote: I love my husband, but when he says "I'll do it later," I know exactly which decade he means.

D.quote: My phone has six hundred contacts and I answer four of them.

C.quote: I used to dread being the oldest person in the room. Now I just look for the chair.

D.quote: I apologize to furniture when I bump into it. Except the coffee table. That asshole knows what it did.

C.quote: I've reached the age where "new and improved" just means they moved the thing I needed.

D.quote: My favorite exercise is closing a drawer with my hip.
